title: StoreEntry
description: A value kept by StorePort (layer harness): small JSON with the version compare-and-set checks against.

value.description: Any JSON value: null, boolean, number, string, array or object.

version.description: Grows with every write of the key and is never reused for it, even after a delete or an expiry.

expiresAt.description: After this time the key reads as absent.
